THE ASSIGNMENT
ContextContributionRelated expertise

Feasibility Study under the Global Partnership for Education Program Development Grant, with MoPME and ADB

The question
behind the work.

Conducted the feasibility study for a national-level project aiming to scale blended learning and drive digital transformation across pre-primary and primary education in Bangladesh.

Analytical contribution.

  1. 01

    Evaluated the technical feasibility of digital and AI-powered learning and assessment interventions.

  2. 02

    Conducted market and institutional analysis to support digital content creation, LMS use, and real-time assessment.

  3. 03

    Analyzed risks related to climate, disaster resilience, and continuity of learning.

  4. 04

    Developed financial and economic cost-benefit models aligned with the Planning Division and ADB guidelines.

  5. 05

    Engaged with MOPME, DPE, and cross-sector stakeholders for a future-proof, tech-enabled learning system.
